title: AS Security key update
text: The UE shall:
1 >  if UE is connected to E-UTRA/EPC or E-UTRA/5GC:
2 >  upon reception of sk-Counter as specified in TS 36.331 :
3 >  update the S-K key based on the K key and using the received sk-Counter value, as specified in TS gNB eNB 33.401 for EN-DC, or TS 33.501 for NGEN-DC;
3 >  derive the K and K keys as specified in TS 33.401 for EN-DC, or TS 33.501 for RRCenc UPenc NGEN-DC;
3 >  derive the K and K keys as specified in TS 33.401 for EN-DC or TS 33.501 for NGEN- RRCint UPint DC.
1 >  else if this procedure was initiated due to reception of the masterKeyUpdate:
2 >  if the nas-Container is included in the received masterKeyUpdate:
3 >  forward the nas-Container to the upper layers;
2 >  if the keySetChangeIndicator is set to true:
3 >  derive or update the K key based on the K key, as specified in TS 33.501 ;
3 >  derive or update the K key based on the current K key or the NH, using the nextHopChainingCount gNB gNB value indicated in the received masterKeyUpdate, as specified in TS 33.501 ;
2 >  store the nextHopChainingCount value;
2 >  derive the keys associated with the K key as follows:
3 >  if the securityAlgorithmConfig is included in SecurityConfig:
4 >  derive the K and K keys associated with the cipheringAlgorithm indicated in the RRCenc UPenc securityAlgorithmConfig, as specified in TS 33.501 ;
4 >  derive the K and K keys associated with the integrityProtAlgorithm indicated in the RRCint UPint securityAlgorithmConfig, as specified in TS 33.501 ;
4 >  derive the K and K keys associated with the current cipheringAlgorithm, as specified in TS RRCenc UPenc
4 >  derive the K and K keys associated with the current integrityProtAlgorithm, as specified in RRCint UPint TS 33.501 .
NOTE 1: Ciphering and integrity protection are optional to configure for the DRBs.
1 >  else if this procedure was initiated due to reception of the sk-Counter (UE is in NE-DC, or NR-DC, or is configured with SN terminated bearer(s)):
2 >  derive or update the secondary key (S-K or S-KeNB) based on the KgNB key and using the received sk- gNB Counter value, as specified in TS 33.501 ;

2 >  derive the K key and the K key as specified in TS 33.501 using the ciphering algorithms RRCenc UPenc indicated in the RadioBearerConfig associated with the secondary key (S-K or S-KeNB) as indicated by gNB keyToUse;

2 >  derive the K key and the K key as specified in TS 33.501 using the integrity protection RRCint UPint algorithms indicated in the RadioBearerConfig associated with the secondary key (S-K or S-KeNB) as gNB indicated by keyToUse;   NOTE 2: If the UE has no radio bearer configured with keyToUse set to secondary and receives the sk-Counter without any RadioBearerConfig with keyToUse set to secondary, the UE does not consider it as an invalid reconfiguration.
